section_I.interpretation: The V2.1.1 STOP was caused by a provably-wrong historical stored counter (service_closeouts.incident_count=0), not by database drift after the audit or by later lifecycle processing silently invalidating a once-true fact. Full genealogy: economicBoundaryEngine.js resumed a closeout attempt that serviceLifecycleEngine.js had already classified 6 incidents against, and passed hardcoded zero counters to the shared service_closeouts writer without ever querying service_incidents. Fixed at the specification level in V2.1.2 by widening S18's scope to make closeout counters a live, correlation-scoped, server-derived fact rather than a caller-supplied integer.

root_cause_9746dfdd_section_I.closeout_writer_caller: src/serviceSessions/economicBoundaryEngine.js rollEconomicPeriod(), Phase D, lines 215-216 - hardcoded literal 0 for kitchenPendingCount/listoCount/deliveryPendingCount/incidentCount/criticalIncidentCount
root_cause_9746dfdd_section_I.mechanism: service_closeout_attempts.acquire() is origin-agnostic (keyed by service_session_id alone); capture_closeout_snapshot is idempotent by correlation_id (a resumed attempt gets back the existing snapshot, created:false). Both are correct by design. economicBoundaryEngine.js never queries service_incidents at all and never re-derives from what an earlier, different engine may already have persisted under the same correlation.
root_cause_9746dfdd_section_I.financial_impact: NONE - confirmed zero writes to table_order_lines, payment_allocations, payment_transactions, order_financial_events, or orden_estado_logs in either incident-creation window (2026-08-10T15:32-15:42Z and 2026-08-11T07:44-07:55Z)
root_cause_9746dfdd_section_I.fix_owner: S18 (scope explicitly widened in V2.1.2 to include economicBoundaryEngine.rollEconomicPeriod and serviceCloseoutCreation.js)
root_cause_9746dfdd_section_I.canonical_counter_source: live, closeout_correlation_id-scoped COUNT(*) against public.service_incidents, evaluated at the moment of the service_closeouts INSERT; never a caller-supplied integer
